text.strap: Redmarsh Rovers dominate early phase
text.card: By minute 7, Redmarsh Rovers have swung momentum from +3.3 to -70.2, indicating a strong control shift. Their possession at 63.4% and 3 box entries with 1 shot on target contrast sharply with Halcyon City's 36.6% possession and no shots, setting a tactical upper hand.

text.strap: Halcyon City under early pressure
text.card: Halcyon City has had a tough start, with Redmarsh Rovers controlling the ball 63% of the time and already testing the goal. We need to step up and get back into the game soon!

text.strap: Redmarsh domina desde el inicio
text.card: A los 7 minutos, Redmarsh Rovers controla el partido con un 63.4% de posesión y un disparo a puerta. Halcyon City aún no ha logrado disparar. ¡Esto es una señal clara de que estamos tomando ventaja!

text.strap: Redmarsh prend le jeu tôt
text.card: À la 7e minute, Redmarsh Rovers domine avec 63,4% de possession et un tir cadré. Ezra Lazaro doit rester vigilant car l'équipe adverse est déjà bien en place.

text.strap: Rask blocks 0.91 xG chance at 08:05
text.card: At 08:05, Luca Rask's shot from 1.5m at 76.3 km/h was blocked despite a 0.914 xG, reflecting Redmarsh's 66.6% possession and 97.3% field tilt. Early dominance but difficulty converting chances.

text.strap: Rask’s big chance blocked early on
text.card: Early in the game, Redmarsh's Luca Rask had a great chance but his shot was blocked close to goal. Our Halcyon City defense is holding strong despite their control of the ball so far.

text.strap: Rask falla una gran oportunidad al 08:05
text.card: A los 08:05, Luca Rask tuvo una gran oportunidad con un valor esperado de gol de 0.914, pero su disparo fue bloqueado desde solo 1.5 metros. Dominamos con 66.6% de posesión pero seguimos sin marcar.

text.strap: Rask bloque, chance manquée à 08:05
text.card: À 08:05, Luca Rask a tiré à 76,3 km/h à 1,5m, mais son tir a été bloqué. Redmarsh domine avec 66,6% de possession, mais le score reste nul. Ezra Lazaro doit rester vigilant en défense.

text.strap: Fontaine's counter disrupts Redmarsh control
text.card: Bastian Fontaine scored at 11:55 via an 18m counter-attack shot at 87 km/h, Halcyon's first shot and goal (xG 0.11). Despite Redmarsh's 56.4% possession and 1.21 xG from 3 shots, Halcyon leads 1-0, shifting tactical momentum early.

text.strap: Fontaine sorprende en contraataque
text.card: Fontaine marcó para Halcyon City al minuto 11:55 con un disparo de contraataque a 87 km/h desde 18 metros. Aunque Redmarsh domina con 56.4% posesión y 1.21 xG, vamos perdiendo 0-1 y debemos reaccionar rápido.

text.strap: But de Fontaine sur contre-attaque
text.card: Fontaine a marqué à la 11:55 avec un tir en contre de 18 mètres à 87 km/h. Halcyon mène 1-0 malgré la domination de Redmarsh, mais Ezra Lazaro doit rester vigilant car le momentum est en faveur de l'adversaire.

text.strap: Fontaine's counter goal gives Halcyon City an early lead
text.card: Bastian Fontaine scored for Halcyon City at 11:55 with a counter-attack shot from 18 meters, clocked at 87 km/h. This was Halcyon's first shot and goal, despite Redmarsh Rovers controlling possession and creating higher xG chances.

text.card: Redmarsh Rovers nearly scored on a fast counter at 13:57, but Hugo Ueda’s shot was blocked. Despite leading 1-0, Halcyon City must stay alert as Redmarsh holds over half the possession and is pushing hard.

text.strap: Ueda falla gran oportunidad en contraataque
text.card: Al minuto 13:57, Hugo Ueda de Redmarsh Rovers tuvo una gran oportunidad con valor esperado de gol 0.645, pero su disparo fue bloqueado tras un rápido contraataque iniciado por Callum Abernath. Redmarsh domina con 52.5% de posesión y 73.6% de control del campo.

text.strap: Occasion bloquée pour Ueda en contre rapide
text.card: À 13:57, Hugo Ueda a vu son tir (xG 0,645) bloqué lors d’un contre rapide initié par Callum Abernath. Ezra Lazaro observe un match serré, Redmarsh domine le ballon (52,5%) mais est mené 1-0 par Halcyon City.

text.strap: Hugo Ueda blocks a 0.65 xG chance in Redmarsh's counter…
text.card: At 13:57, Hugo Ueda of Redmarsh Rovers missed a big chance with an expected goal value of 0.645, as his shot was blocked during a fast counter attack. Callum Abernath provided the key pass leading to this opportunity. Despite trailing…

text.strap: Halcyon City takes control with 70% possession
text.card: At 14:23, Halcyon City shifted to a control regime, securing 70% possession and an 86% pass completion rate over the last 5 minutes. This tactical adjustment stabilizes their 1-0 lead against Redmarsh, who press intensely but lose possession frequently.

text.strap: Halcyon City controls the game now!
text.card: Great news! Since 14:23, our Halcyon City has been dominating, holding 70% possession and completing 86% of passes in the last 5 minutes. We're leading 1-0 and managing the game well against Redmarsh's tough pressing.

text.strap: Redmarsh pierde control ante Halcyon
text.card: Desde el minuto 14:23, Halcyon City domina con un 70% de posesión y 86% de pases completados en los últimos 5 minutos. Redmarsh Rovers presionan mucho pero pierden la pelota más a menudo. Vamos a recuperar el control pronto.

text.strap: Halcyon City prend le contrôle à 14:23
text.card: À 14:23, Halcyon City a pris le contrôle du jeu avec 70% de possession et 86% de passes réussies sur les 5 dernières minutes. Ezra Lazaro et son équipe gèrent leur avance 1-0 face à Redmarsh, qui presse fort mais perd souvent le ballon.

text.strap: Isak Quarry heads Redmarsh level at 1-1
text.card: At 14:25, Quarry scored an 8m header assisted by Fallow, equalizing for Redmarsh. Their 54% possession and 7 shots versus Halcyon’s 46% and 1 shot mark a momentum shift favoring Redmarsh, disrupting Halcyon's prior control phase.

text.strap: Halcyon City conceded equalizer at 15'
text.card: Oh no! Isak Quarry just scored a header for Redmarsh at 14:25 to make it 1-1. We had more control before, but now Redmarsh is pushing hard with more shots and possession. Let’s hope we can bounce back!

text.strap: ¡Isak Quarry empata para Redmarsh al 15'!
text.card: ¡Qué golazo! Isak Quarry cabeceó a 8 metros tras pase de Bram Fallow para empatar 1-1 a los 14:25. Redmarsh domina con 54% de posesión y 7 tiros, controlando el partido y la energía ahora mismo.

text.strap: Égalisation de Redmarsh par Isak Quarry
text.card: Isak Quarry a marqué de la tête à 8 mètres, assisté par Bram Fallow à la 14:25, égalisant pour Redmarsh. Halcyon perd le contrôle, Redmarsh domine avec 54% de possession et 7 tirs. Ezra Lazaro doit rester vigilant !

text.strap: Ayo Arkwell → Callum Abernath
Redmarsh Rovers dominate with 3 shots, 3 box entries
text.card: At 19 minutes, Redmarsh Rovers have executed 3 shots and 3 box entries in 5 minutes, holding 59.3% possession and a 75% field tilt. Momentum shifted drastically from +3.2 to -71.6 favoring Redmarsh, indicating strong territorial and attacking dominance over Halcyon City.

text.strap: Halcyon City under pressure as Redmarsh attacks surge
text.card: At 19 minutes, Redmarsh Rovers have fired 3 shots and entered the box 3 times in the last 5 minutes, while Halcyon City has had none. Redmarsh controls most of the ball and field, putting us under heavy pressure. We need to regain control to turn things around.

text.strap: Redmarsh Rovers domina con 3 tiros y 3 entradas al área
text.card: A los 19 minutos, Redmarsh Rovers ha lanzado 3 tiros y entrado 3 veces al área en 5 minutos, controlando el 59.3% de la posesión y el 75% del campo. El momento ha cambiado mucho a nuestro favor, mostrando que estamos dominando el partido y presionando fuerte a Halcyon.

text.strap: Redmarsh domine avec 3 tirs et 3 entrées en 5 min
text.card: À la 19e minute, Redmarsh Rovers a tiré 3 fois et pénétré 3 fois dans la surface en 5 minutes. Ils contrôlent 59,3% de la possession et 75% du terrain, ce qui montre une forte domination. Ezra Lazaro doit rester vigilant pour aider Halcyon à réagir.

text.strap: Redmarsh Rovers dominate possession at 20 minutes
text.card: At 20 minutes, Redmarsh Rovers control 66% possession with 79% pass accuracy, 9 shots and 11 box entries, compared to Halcyon City's 1 shot and 2 entries. This tactical dominance shifts momentum firmly in Redmarsh's favor despite the 1-1 score.

text.strap: Halcyon City struggling to keep up at 20 minutes
text.card: Halcyon City is finding it tough, with only 1 shot and 2 box entries in the last 20 minutes. Redmarsh Rovers have the ball much more and are making lots of attacks. The score is still tied at 1-1, so hope remains!

text.strap: Redmarsh domina con 66% de posesión a 20 minutos
text.card: Redmarsh Rovers tiene el control con 66% de posesión y 79% de pases completados. Han intentado 9 tiros y entrado 11 veces al área, frente a 1 tiro y 2 entradas de Halcyon City. El marcador sigue 1-1, pero dominamos el juego.

text.strap: Redmarsh contrôle le jeu à 20 minutes
text.card: À la 20e minute, Redmarsh Rovers domine avec 66% de possession et 79% de passes réussies. Ils ont tiré 9 fois et sont entrés 11 fois dans la surface, contre 1 tir et 2 entrées pour Halcyon City. Ezra Lazaro doit rester vigilant malgré le score 1-1.

text.card: At 24', Halcyon City initiated a pressing spell with 9 pressure actions in 6 minutes, nearly twice their baseline rate (1.94x). Despite Redmarsh holding 54.9% possession and 70.6% field tilt, Halcyon's pressing forced 3 turnovers, shifting momentum in their favor in a level 1-1 match.

text.strap: Halcyon City steps up pressing, fights for control
text.card: Halcyon City has really turned up the heat in the last 6 minutes with 9 intense pressure actions, almost double usual. Even though Redmarsh has the ball more, our pressing caused 3 turnovers, giving us hope to take control in this 1-1 game!

text.strap: Redmarsh domina, pero Halcyon presiona fuerte
text.card: A los 24 minutos, Halcyon City ha intensificado su presión con 9 acciones en 6 minutos, casi el doble de lo habitual. Aunque dominamos la posesión (54.9%) y el campo (70.6%), la presión de Halcyon provocó 3 pérdidas de balón. Partido igualado 1-1.

text.strap: Halcyon intensifie la pression, match serré
text.card: À la 24e, Halcyon City a lancé une phase de pressing avec 9 actions en 6 minutes, presque deux fois plus que leur rythme habituel. Malgré la possession (54,9%) et le contrôle du terrain (70,6%) de Redmarsh, ce pressing a causé 3 pertes de balle. Score 1-1, momentum pour Halcyon.

text.strap: Cardell misses high xG header for Halcyon City
text.card: At 24:28, Cardell's header from 6.1m had an xG of 0.352 but went off target. Despite Redmarsh's 54.6% possession and 67.4% field tilt, Halcyon City is gaining momentum with effective pressing (49 pressures).

text.strap: So close! Cardell misses great chance
text.card: Tomas Cardell just missed a big header chance at 24:28 after a great pass by Nico Nakamura. Halcyon City is pressing hard and building momentum despite being level at 1-1. Keep the faith, we’re creating good chances!

text.strap: Cardell falla oportunidad clara para Halcyon
text.card: A los 24:28, Tomas Cardell falló un cabezazo con 0.352 de xG tras un pase clave de Nico Nakamura. Aunque Redmarsh controla el juego con 54.6% posesión, Halcyon gana impulso. El marcador sigue 1-1.

text.strap: Cardell rate une grosse occasion de la tête
text.card: À 24:28, Tomas Cardell a manqué une tête à 6.1 m avec un xG de 0.352, suite à une passe clé de Nico Nakamura. Le match est à 1-1, Halcyon City presse bien malgré la domination de Redmarsh.

text.strap: Redmarsh Rovers dominate with 3 box entries, 108 pressures
text.card: Redmarsh Rovers have increased their momentum drastically, now holding 55.5% possession and applying 108 pressures versus Halcyon City's 63. Their 3 box entries and 1 shot in the last 5 minutes underline tactical control in this 1-1 match.

text.strap: Halcyon City under pressure as Rovers push hard
text.card: Halcyon City is feeling the heat as Redmarsh Rovers take control with 3 attacks into the box and a shot in the last 5 minutes. We still hold hope though, the score is level at 1-1 and there’s plenty of time left.

text.strap: Redmarsh Rovers domina con 3 entradas al área
text.card: Redmarsh Rovers domina el partido con 3 entradas al área y un disparo en los últimos 5 minutos. Controlamos el balón el 55.5% del tiempo y presionamos mucho, ¡esto nos da esperanza en el empate 1-1!

text.strap: Redmarsh Rovers intensifient la pression et dominent
text.card: Ezra Lazaro et son équipe, Redmarsh Rovers, ont pris l’avantage du momentum avec 3 incursions dans la surface et un tir en 5 minutes. Ils contrôlent 55.5% du ballon et pressent fort (108 pressions) dans ce match à 1-1.

Rovers dominate with 73% possession & 76.6% field tilt
text.card: Redmarsh Rovers have established clear control since the 37th minute, holding 73% possession and an 84% pass completion rate over the last 5 minutes. Their field tilt at 76.6% and 127 pressures versus Halcyon City's 79 underline their tactical dominance and momentum advantage.

text.strap: Halcyon City under pressure as Rovers control game
text.card: Halcyon City is struggling to keep the ball lately, with Redmarsh Rovers holding it 73% of the time in the last 5 minutes. The Rovers are passing well and putting a lot of pressure on our players, making it hard for us to create chances.

text.strap: Rovers controlan con 73% de posesión y 76.6% de dominio
text.card: Desde el minuto 37, Redmarsh Rovers domina el juego con un 73% de posesión en los últimos 5 minutos y un 84% de pases completados. Controlan el campo con un 76.6% y presionan mucho más que Halcyon City, mostrando un claro dominio y esperanza para ganar.

text.strap: Rovers contrôlent le jeu avec 73% de possession
text.card: Depuis la 37e minute, Redmarsh Rovers tiennent le ballon 73% du temps sur les 5 dernières minutes, avec un taux de passes réussies de 84%. Ils imposent leur rythme sur le terrain, ce qui laisse Ezra Lazaro sous pression pour trouver des solutions.

text.strap: Halcyon City gains momentum with 5 box entries
text.card: Halcyon City reversed momentum from -52.1 to +75.9 by registering 5 box entries in 5 minutes without shots. Despite no attempts, their attacking control surges, pressuring Redmarsh Rovers as the game stays level at 1-1 at halftime.

text.strap: Halcyon City pushing hard before halftime
text.card: Great to see Halcyon City getting into the box 5 times in the last 5 minutes before halftime! Even though no shots were taken, they're really turning the pressure up. The score’s still tied 1-1, so the second half could be exciting!

text.strap: Halcyon City domina sin disparos antes del descanso
text.card: Halcyon City ha ganado impulso con 5 entradas al área en los últimos 5 minutos, aunque sin disparos. El partido sigue empatado 1-1 al descanso, pero la presión para los Redmarsh Rovers aumenta.

text.strap: Halcyon City multiplie les incursions avant la pause
text.card: Halcyon City a pris l’ascendant avec 5 incursions dans la surface en 5 minutes, sans tirer. Le match est toujours à 1-1 à la mi-temps, Ezra Lazaro et son équipe mettent la pression pour la seconde période.

text.strap: Halcyon City doubles pressing rate to disrupt Rovers
text.card: Halcyon City has increased their pressing actions to 10 in 6 minutes, 2.08 times their baseline of 1.21. This intensified press forced 3 turnovers and reduced Redmarsh Rovers' pass accuracy from 81.2% to 72%, shifting momentum at 1-1.

text.strap: Halcyon City steps up the pressure!
text.card: Halcyon City is really pressing hard now, doubling their usual effort with 10 pressure moves in 6 minutes. They've forced 3 mistakes from Redmarsh, whose passing is slipping. With the game tied, this surge could lead to a big chance!

text.strap: Redmarsh sufre la presión de Halcyon
text.card: Halcyon City ha aumentado la presión, con 10 acciones en 6 minutos, más del doble de lo normal. Esto ha provocado 3 pérdidas para Redmarsh, que ha bajado su precisión de pase al 72%. El partido está empatado y debemos recuperarnos rápido.

text.strap: Halcyon City intensifie sa pression
text.card: Halcyon City a doublé son intensité de pressing avec 10 actions en 6 minutes, forçant 3 pertes de balle à Redmarsh. La précision de passe adverse chute à 72%. Avec le score à 1-1, cette pression peut créer des opportunités dans les 43 minutes restantes.

text.strap: Abernath's 0.31 xG header blocked early 2nd half
text.card: At 46:51, Abernath missed a 0.31 expected goal header from 6.8m, blocked after a 52.6 km/h cross by Ueda. Despite Redmarsh's 55% possession and 165 pressures, Halcyon City sustains momentum in a 1-1 match with 44 mins left.

text.strap: Halcyon holds firm as Abernath's header blocked
text.card: Early second half, Abernath had a big chance with a header but it was blocked. Even though Redmarsh controls the ball more, Halcyon City is holding strong and the score stays 1-1 with plenty of time left!

text.strap: Abernath falla un cabezazo claro al inicio del 2º tiempo
text.card: Al minuto 46:51, Abernath tuvo una gran oportunidad con un cabezazo desde 6.8 m, pero fue bloqueado. Redmarsh domina la posesión con 55%, pero el marcador sigue 1-1. ¡Queda mucho partido para remontar!

text.strap: Chance manquée d'Abernath en début de seconde mi-temps
text.card: À 46:51, Abernath a manqué une grosse occasion de la tête à 6,8 m, son tir a été bloqué après un centre à 52,6 km/h de Ueda. Le match est nul 1-1, Halcyon City maintient la pression malgré la possession supérieure de Redmarsh.

text.strap: Regime shifts to chaos with 4 turnovers/min
text.card: At 47:43 in the second half, possession regime shifted from balanced to chaos, marked by 4 turnovers per minute. Halcyon City controls 55% possession in last 5 minutes, but Redmarsh Rovers lead momentum despite less possession, indicating tactical resilience and pressure shifts.

text.strap: Game gets wild but we hold most possession
text.card: The game got crazy after halftime with lots of back-and-forth. We have the ball 55% of the time in the last 5 minutes, but Redmarsh Rovers are still pushing hard. Stay strong, Halcyon City fans!

text.strap: Caos en el juego, pero seguimos fuertes
text.card: El partido se volvió caótico tras el descanso con muchos cambios de posesión. Aunque Halcyon City tiene más balón (55%), nosotros mantenemos el impulso y seguimos luchando. ¡Vamos Redmarsh Rovers!

text.strap: Le match devient chaotique après la pause
text.card: À 47:43, le jeu bascule dans le chaos avec 4 changements de possession par minute. Halcyon City garde 55 % de possession ces 5 dernières minutes, mais Redmarsh Rovers ont le momentum malgré moins de possession. Ezra Lazaro doit rester vigilant!

text.strap: Cardell doubles touches, boosts Halcyon midfield
text.card: Tomas Cardell has significantly increased his involvement post-restart with 18 touches in 12 minutes, over twice the expected 6.1. His 92% pass completion, 2 dribbles, and 4 interceptions demonstrate high midfield influence, crucial as Halcyon tries to regain control in a chaotic 1-1 match favoring Redmarsh.

text.strap: Cardell’s big impact lifts Halcyon hopes
text.card: Since the second half started, Cardell has been everywhere! He’s touched the ball 18 times, more than double what we expected, keeping passes sharp and breaking up Redmarsh attacks. We need this energy to turn the game our way and get that winning goal!

text.strap: Cardell domina en el medio, ojo con Halcyon
text.card: Desde el reinicio, Cardell ha aumentado sus toques a 18 en 12 minutos, más del doble de lo esperado. Su precisión del 92% en pases y 4 intercepciones muestran que Halcyon City quiere controlar el juego, aunque el momento favorece a Redmarsh en este empate 1-1.

text.strap: Cardell prend le jeu en main pour Halcyon
text.card: Cardell s’illustre avec 18 touches en 12 minutes, bien au-dessus des 6 attendues. Avec 92% de passes réussies, 2 dribbles et 4 interceptions, il est très actif au milieu, essentiel pour stabiliser Halcyon dans ce match équilibré.

text.strap: Rask’s counter goal shifts momentum to Redmarsh
text.card: At 51:59, Luca Rask scored on a rapid counterattack assisted by Tariq Thorne, with a 13.7m shot at 84.8 km/h and an xG of 0.23. This goal completed Redmarsh Rovers' comeback, giving them a 2-1 lead and 54.3% possession in a chaotic second half with 38 minutes left.

text.strap: Rask’s goal puts Redmarsh ahead 2-1
text.card: Luca Rask scored quickly on the break at 52 minutes, assisted by Tariq Thorne. Redmarsh Rovers came from behind to lead 2-1 with over half the ball in a wild second half. We need to fight back with 38 minutes left!

text.strap: Gol de Rask pone a Redmarsh 2-1 arriba
text.card: ¡Qué gol de Luca Rask con un contragolpe rápido a los 52 minutos, asistido por Tariq Thorne! Redmarsh Rovers completa la remontada y ahora domina con un 54.3% de posesión y ventaja 2-1 en esta segunda mitad intensa con 38 minutos por jugar.

text.strap: But de Rask, contre rapide, Redmarsh mène 2-1
text.card: Luca Rask a marqué à la 52e minute sur un contre rapide, assisté par Tariq Thorne. Le tir de 13,7 m à 84,8 km/h a permis à Redmarsh de prendre l’avantage 2-1. Match chaotique, 38 minutes restantes.

text.strap: Redmarsh down to 10 after Steen’s red
text.card: At 54', Kian Steen (LB) received a second yellow, reducing Redmarsh Rovers to 10 while leading 2-1. Despite numerical disadvantage, Redmarsh retains a 26.5 momentum edge in a chaotic phase, demanding tactical discipline to hold the lead.

text.strap: Rojo a Steen, Rovers con 10 jugadores
text.card: Al minuto 54, Kian Steen recibió la segunda amarilla y fue expulsado. Quedan 36 minutos difíciles, pero los Rovers mantienen la ventaja 2-1 y aún dominan el juego con un impulso favorable a pesar de jugar con uno menos.

text.strap: Steen exclu, Rovers à 10
text.card: À la 54e, Kian Steen a reçu un second jaune et a été expulsé. Les Rovers mènent 2-1 mais doivent jouer à 10 pour les 36 dernières minutes dans un match chaotique. Ezra Lazaro devra s'adapter à cette situation difficile.

text.card: At 55:44, Redmarsh Rovers took control even though they have one less player. They've had 2 shots and got into the box twice in the last 5 minutes, while Halcyon hasn't managed any chances. We need to keep fighting to get back into the game!

text.strap: Redmarsh domina con un jugador menos
text.card: A las 55:44, Redmarsh Rovers tomó el control a pesar de jugar con 10. En los últimos 5 minutos tuvieron 2 disparos y 2 entradas en el área, mientras Halcyon no tuvo ninguna. Esto muestra la fuerza y el control de nuestro equipo, ¡vamos Rovers!

text.strap: Redmarsh contrôle malgré 10 contre 11
text.card: À 55:44, Redmarsh Rovers a pris l'avantage malgré un joueur en moins. Ils ont tenté 2 tirs et pénétré deux fois la surface en 5 minutes, Halcyon n’a rien créé. Ezra Lazaro et ses coéquipiers montrent une belle maîtrise du jeu.
